title: A slower way to discover Kerala
excerpt: Backwater mornings, tea-covered hills and coastal pauses: ideas for a more unhurried Kerala escape.
author: MAKE MY TOUR Editorial
body: Kerala rewards travellers who leave room in the itinerary. Rather than racing between landmarks, consider giving each region time to unfold.
Begin with the old streets and waterfront of Kochi, then travel inland towards the cooler hill country around Munnar. The changing landscape is part of the experience.
Finish near the backwaters, where a quiet morning can be as memorable as a full day of sightseeing. Confirm seasonal conditions, transfers and accommodation details before travelling.

title: Planning your first international holiday
excerpt: A practical starting point for documents, budgets, connectivity and a comfortable travel rhythm.
author: MAKE MY TOUR Editorial
body: A first international trip becomes easier when the essentials are handled early. Start by checking passport validity and the entry requirements for your destination using official government sources.
Build a realistic budget that includes local transport, meals, travel insurance, connectivity and a contingency amount. Compare flight timings as well as fares.
Keep digital and printed copies of important documents, understand your baggage allowance and leave some unscheduled time in your itinerary.

title: Getting ready for a mountain holiday
excerpt: Altitude, weather and pacing deserve as much attention as the views.
author: MAKE MY TOUR Editorial
body: Mountain destinations can change quickly with altitude, weather and road conditions. Build flexibility into the plan and follow local guidance.

For high-altitude destinations, acclimatisation is not optional itinerary padding. It is an important part of safer travel. Seek medical advice if you have concerns about altitude or existing health conditions.
Pack layers, sun protection and suitable footwear, and check local advisories close to departure.
